name: loop-graph-design
description: Interview the owner into a grounded agent loop, then emit the runnable prompt or script that starts it.

interface.shortDescription: Turn repeating work into a grounded running loop
interface.longDescription: Adds a provider-neutral Skill that interviews the owner for a loop's intent, anchor, quantified stop condition, boundary, and independent verifier, refuses the topologies that fail in production, and compiles a machine-consumable artifact: a /goal or /loop prompt package, a Workflow script, or a cross-vendor delegation package. Topology stays model-authored; only the package surface is mechanically checked.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $loop-graph-design to turn repeating work into a loop with an anchor and an owner-defined stop condition.
